'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Chris Westergard LS Infiltration''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Westergard]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Infiltration / Unlikely Allies]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
